comparison.objective: Select and seat corrosion-compatible fittings in two mixed-metal pipe gaps; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Part classification, orientation, and coupling insertion versus hex-key alignment, collar adjustment, counterholding, and controlled tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly oriented dielectric union and copper coupling seated and released without disturbing the run versus validated dynamic stops. Seating tolerances are absent and no separate specs exist.
comparison.reason: Correct fitting selection and insertion do not test adjustable energy absorption.
